Space Vocabulary

🔊 Voice:

Welcome, space explorer!

Write your name and class, then start the 6 missions.

📖 Lesson slides

Click the slide (or press → / Space) to show the next part. ← goes back.

Mission 1 · Vocabulary: Drag and drop

Drag each word to the right picture. (On a tablet you can also tap a word, then tap a picture.)

Mission 2 · Spelling: Missing letters

Listen 🔊 and type the missing letters.

Mission 3 · Listening: Listen and choose

Press ▶ Listen. Choose the picture that matches what you hear.

Mission 4 · Speaking: Listen and repeat

1) Press 🔊 to listen. 2) Press 🎤 and say it. 3) Press ▶ to hear yourself.

Mission 5 · Reading: True or False?

Read about Anna. You can press 🔊 to listen too.

Is it True (T) or False (F)?

Mission 6 · Writing: Complete the sentences

Use the words in the box. Then write about you.

Write 2–3 sentences: Would you like to be an astronaut? Why?
